title: update_task
description: Update the title, description, or completion status of an existing task for the authenticated user. This tool should be used when the user wants to modify, change, edit, or update a task. Natural language examples: 'Change my report task to finish by Friday', 'Update the grocery list to include eggs', 'Actually, make it almond milk instead'. NOTE: If task_id is not provided, the agent should first use list_tasks to find the matching task.

user_id.description: The authenticated user's ID (extracted from JWT token). Required for user data isolation.

task_id.description: The unique ID of the task to update. If not provided by user, agent should use list_tasks to find matching task by title/description.

title.description: New title for the task (1-200 characters). Only include if user wants to change the title.

description.description: New description for the task. Only include if user wants to change the description. Set to null to remove description.

completed.description: New completion status. Only include if user wants to toggle completion (prefer complete_task tool for marking as done).

examples.description: Milk, eggs, bread, and almond butter

success.description: Whether the task was updated successfully

task.description: The updated task object with modified fields

message.description: User-friendly confirmation message (e.g., 'Updated task: Buy groceries and cook dinner')

errors.description: Task with given ID does not exist or does not belong to user
Title is empty or exceeds 200 characters, or description exceeds 1000 characters
User ID mismatch or invalid JWT token
Failed to update task in database

agent_notes: If user references a task by title/description (e.g., 'update the grocery task'), chain list_tasks first to find the task_id
If user says 'change it to...' or 'make it...', use conversation context to identify the most recently referenced task
If multiple tasks match, ask user to clarify which one
Only include fields that user wants to change (partial updates supported)
For marking tasks as done, prefer using complete_task tool instead of update_task with completed=true
